cases.name: etaf-video-tests-renders-ascii-ramp-frames
cases.purpose: Every canvas pixel is the ramp character of its grayscale byte, and the producer receives the documented gray scale and read rate.

cases.name: etaf-video-tests-renders-color-half-blocks
cases.purpose: Color mode maps two full-color pixels into one half-block cell with the fixture's foreground and background colors at double-height RGB24.

cases.name: etaf-video-tests-image-canvas-uses-one-line-per-row
cases.purpose: An image-mode canvas publishes one display slice per declared row, so chrome placed under the canvas stays inside the window instead of being pushed off by one tall image line.

cases.name: etaf-video-tests-live-control-sources-survive-resize
cases.purpose: Shared reactive volume, sound and speed sources retune a playing canvas and survive a size rebuild with its presentation-rate setting.

cases.name: etaf-video-tests-image-mode-falls-back-on-terminal
cases.purpose: Image mode renders ASCII when the buffer is not in a graphical frame and reports the effective mode and grayscale format.

cases.name: etaf-video-tests-controls-pause-step-seek-speed
cases.purpose: Pause freezes the position, step presents one more frame, a paused seek presents its target frame, and seek, playback and speed restart the producer with the documented arguments.

cases.name: etaf-video-tests-finishes-and-restarts
cases.purpose: A producer that runs out of frames ends the video, keeps its last picture, and plays again from the start.

cases.name: etaf-video-tests-audio-sidecar-follows-playback
cases.purpose: An audio source starts one ffplay sidecar with the documented arguments while playing and releases it on pause.

cases.name: etaf-video-tests-streams-http-url
cases.purpose: An HTTP URL reaches ffmpeg with reconnect options and presents a paused first frame while a non-HTTP scheme is rejected.

cases.name: etaf-video-tests-normalizes-separate-audio-stream
cases.purpose: A split audio stream keeps its URL as the audio target, a present audio URL implies audio, and ffprobe receives the source headers and proxy without probing the audio URL.

cases.name: etaf-video-tests-streams-separate-audio-with-network-options
cases.purpose: A split HTTP(S) source sends video to ffmpeg and audio to ffplay, both with the same User-Agent, headers and proxy, while the producer never opens the audio URL.

cases.name: etaf-video-tests-restarts-on-input-change
cases.purpose: A canvas size change republishes the canvas and rebuilds the session with the new scale at the same paused position.

cases.name: etaf-video-tests-ended-video-redraws-at-new-size
cases.purpose: Resizing an ended video presents its last frame at the new canvas size instead of keeping the old picture.

cases.name: etaf-video-tests-unmount-releases-runtime-and-handle
cases.purpose: Unmounting stops producer processes and makes the released handle unaddressable.

cases.name: etaf-video-tests-expands-local-file-names
cases.purpose: A local source named with ~ or relative to the default directory reaches ffprobe as an absolute file name.

cases.name: etaf-video-tests-normalized-source-skips-second-probe
cases.purpose: A metadata plist from etaf-video-source-info mounts with its values and without another ffprobe call.

cases.name: etaf-video-tests-embeds-in-a-layout-and-drives-by-interaction
cases.purpose: A video sits in a layout as one fixed box next to ordinary siblings, and the consumer's on-press gesture toggles playback through the handle.

cases.name: etaf-video-tests-rejects-invalid-inputs
cases.purpose: Invalid render props report a Component call error and unknown handles report a user error.

cases.name: etaf-video-tests-seek-and-speed-stop-playing-audio
cases.purpose: Seeking or changing speed while playing immediately stops the old ffplay sidecar before starting the new aligned audio stream.

cases.name: etaf-video-tests-normalized-source-honors-start-offset
cases.purpose: A pre-normalized source plist with :start starts ffmpeg directly at that offset without calling ffprobe.

cases.name: etaf-video-tests-engine-controls-and-mpv-backend
cases.purpose: Public engine controls degrade cleanly on ffmpeg and drive real libmpv properties and backward stepping when available.

cases.name: etaf-video-tests-master-clock-holds-video-until-audio-ready
cases.purpose: The ffmpeg video backend shows Frame 0 immediately, holds while ffplay reports nan during startup, and locks frame presentation to ffplay's live audio clock.

cases.name: etaf-video-tests-mpv-loads-split-audio-url-and-headers
cases.purpose: When libmpv is available, split HTTP video and audio URLs load both tracks without delimiter splitting and forward custom headers containing commas to both requests.

cases.name: etaf-video-tests-mpv-async-tiff-file-ring-and-cleanup
cases.purpose: When libmpv is available in graphical image mode, frames render into a file-backed TIFF ring honoring display-fps and remove all temporary ring files on unmount.

cases.name: etaf-video-tests-render-backend-and-gpu-probe
cases.purpose: `etaf-video-state' reports `:render-backend' and `etaf-video-gpu-available-p' probes safely without signaling.

cases.name: etaf-video-kitty-backend-falls-back-cleanly-in-batch
cases.purpose: Requesting the `kitty' video render backend falls back cleanly to `image'/`ascii' in batch sessions without a Kitty terminal.
